newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mabuhay rises 5.26 pct on earnings hopes.
newsitem.headline: Mabuhay rises 5.26 pct on earnings hopes.

text.p: Philippine chemical firm Mabuhay Vinyl Corp climbed by eight centavos, or 5.26 percent, to 1.60 pesos on Tuesday on expectations of higher earnings this year, brokers said.
"There's bargain-hunting on the issue which is now undervalued. It also has good earnings prospects for this year," said BPI Securities Corp research head Spencer Yap.

Another brokerage firm Sun Hung Kai Securities Philippines Inc said in its research paper it expects a high income growth of 32.5 percent for the company this year to 125.645 million pesos on growing demand for its products.
Mabuhay Vinyl is the country's largest caustic soda and polyvinyl chloride resin manufacturer.
The company has projected a 120 million peso net income this year from 94.8 million pesos in 1996.
A total of 4.40 million Mabuhay shares were traded towards close of the session.
